verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents its own trace ingestion through the SDK or an OpenTelemetry exporter, with agent keys scoped to traces:write. A Timeline view shows everything one agent did during one trial, which covers tracing multi-step runs. The docs never say that spans nest hierarchically or that traces group into sessions or threads; per-trial grouping is the closest documented equivalent. Missing for 10: explicit nested span hierarchy, session/thread grouping of traces, depth of trace data model docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace multi-step agent runs as nested spans grouped into sessions or threads

citations.quote: Use SDK trace ingestion or an OpenTelemetry exporter pointed at Chronicle.
Send them from your own code, from your agent's tool calls, or from an OpenTelemetry exporter, then query them in Timeline or through the SDK.
Everything one agent did during one trial, plus scoring.
A key supplied to your agent process typically has agents:write and traces:write.
